tickets.title: Account security follow-up
tickets.text: Restore Evan Thimblefern’s account access in the client document portal after one-time code failures caused a lockout. Do not change his primary email address.
tickets.evidence: Evan reported that the portal rejected his one-time code twice and then locked the account, preventing him from uploading the requested transfer packet and mortgage statement screenshots; he asked for access restoration without changing his primary email address, and the agreed follow-up is to resto

tickets.title: Follow up on missing signature
tickets.text: Obtain the latest Juniper Jellyfish Benefits statement and the required signature guarantee page to complete the rollover request from Evan’s former-employer 401(k) to Velvet Acorn Custody.

subTasks.title: Identify the missing signature items
subTasks.text: Review the returned paperwork or custodian notice and list each missing signature, initial, date, or capacity designation. Note whether wet ink, electronic signature, witness, notary, or spousal consent is required.

subTasks.title: Send corrected signing instructions
subTasks.text: Prepare a concise follow-up message with the affected document name, the specific pages or fields requiring action, acceptable signing method, and how the client should return the completed item.

subTasks.title: Verify completed packet before resubmission
subTasks.text: After receipt, confirm all signature requirements are complete and legible, then resubmit through the appropriate channel and save confirmation in the client record.

tickets.evidence: the receiving custodian indicated that the rollover request cannot move forward because the latest Juniper Jellyfish Benefits statement and a required signature guarantee page were missing; the unresolved documentation need is dated 2026-08-22.

tickets.title: Resolve beneficiary record mismatch on brokerage account
tickets.text: Address the mismatch between planning notes listing Lila Thimblefern as primary beneficiary and the custodian profile showing no primary beneficiary on file for Evan Thimblefern’s brokerage account.
tickets.evidence: Mira’s review found that planning notes list Lila as primary beneficiary on Evan’s brokerage account while the custodian profile screenshot shows no primary beneficiary on file; the agreed follow-up is to address the mismatch by 2026-08-26.

tickets.title: Coordinate benefits enrollment support
tickets.text: Review Clockwork Clover Systems’ health plan, HSA, disability coverage, group life insurance, and 401(k) deferral choices before Evan submits his annual election decisions.

subTasks.title: Gather enrollment materials from client
subTasks.text: Ask the client for the benefits guide, plan comparison tables, premium costs, employer match details, enrollment portal screenshots if needed, and any questions they want addressed.

subTasks.title: Prepare planning review notes
subTasks.text: Mira Quillwhistle reviews benefit choices for cash-flow impact, retirement contribution opportunities, tax considerations, coverage gaps, and coordination with existing planning assumptions.

subTasks.title: Return decision summary to client
subTasks.text: Provide a plain-language summary of key tradeoffs, items the client must decide directly, and questions to take to the employer benefits administrator or insurer.

subTasks.title: Update planning records after enrollment
subTasks.text: Once the client confirms elections, update planning inputs for premiums, retirement contributions, HSA or FSA amounts, insurance coverage, and employer match assumptions.

tickets.evidence: Evan said Clockwork Clover Systems opened its annual election window and requested review of health plan, HSA, disability coverage, group life, and 401(k) deferral choices before submitting elections; the agreed review is due 2026-08-31.
